HGODLK/MusicOne.body:
# MusicOne

*An Android music player focused on unified visuals, smooth experience, and intuitive motion effects*

[📥 Download installation package](https://github.com/HGODLK/MusicOne/releases) • [📡 Multi-source integration](#-多音源整合) • [📑 Playlist system](#-歌单体系) • [🎼 Audio format support](#-音频格式支持)

---

MusicOne is an Android music player built with Jetpack Compose, supporting Android 6.0 and above.

It forgoes cluttered social modules and ad promotion, focusing on smooth interaction gestures, phone/tablet adaptive layouts, local lossless decoding, and clean audio output.

> **Tip**: The app has a built-in Profile performance configuration. On first launch or after an update, the system may briefly heat up or drop frames while background optimization runs. Wait a moment and it will recover.

## 📡 Multi-source integration

MusicOne follows the design philosophy of "sources as capability." With playback capability at its core, sources are divided into **primary source** and **supplementary sources**:

- **Primary source**: Select one platform as the primary source, which provides the core home recommendations, featured playlists, search and discovery, and personal favorites system.
- **Supplementary sources**: Other platforms and sources can be used together as supplementary sources, handling favorites folder subscriptions, track matching, and playback fill-in.
- **Source identification**: The track's theme color changes according to its source, making it easy to tell where a track comes from during mixed playback.
- **Accounts and permissions**: Playback and audio quality tiers for online tracks follow the corresponding platform's account permissions. Copyright-protected or VIP tracks require logging in with an account that holds the appropriate entitlements.
- **Privacy and security**: Account credentials are stored only in the device's private local storage, and source requests are made directly by the client, with no relay server.
- **Unified media model**: Smooths out differences in protocols, interfaces, and audio formats across sources, unifying gestures, motion effects, and playback queue scheduling.

### Primary sources

| Platform | Status | Description |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **QQ Music** | 🟢 Available | Supports home recommendations, search, playlists, and personal favorites |
| **Local music** | 🟢 Available | Supports importing audio files and local playlist management |
| **NetEase Cloud Music** | 🔴 Not yet supported | Not yet supported; currently usable as a supplementary source |
| **Kugou Music** | 🔴 Not yet supported | Not yet supported; currently usable as a supplementary source |

### Supplementary sources

| Platform | Status | Description |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Bilibili** | 🟢 Available | Supports playback by entering a BV number or link, and can directly fetch and subscribe to account favorites folders |

## 📑 Playlist system

On the "Me" page, playlists are organized into two levels by entry point and management dimension:

- **Level-1 playlists** (permanent core entries):
  - **My Likes**: The main entry for personal favorites (heart-marked). After logging in, it syncs bidirectionally with the primary source's cloud.

Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.body:
# 🛡️ VPN Config Security Filter

---

## 🚀 What's new in v6.0

Main change: **every link is now properly parsed**, rather than checked with regexes against the raw string. Percent-encoding is decoded, `&` and `\u0026` are repaired, and parameter synonyms are reduced to one name. Everything that previously passed as "unreadable — therefore fine" is now rejected.

### 🔬 Parsing and normalization

- ✅ **URI parser instead of regex** — vless / vmess / trojan / hysteria2 / ss / tuic are parsed into a structure
- ✅ **Double decoding** — `&amp;`, `\u0026`, `%5Cu0026`, `¬`
- ✅ **Invisible characters** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, control chars are stripped before checking
- ✅ **Parameter synonyms** — `allowlnsecure` (with lowercase L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Lowercase scheme** — `VLESS://` no longer breaks parsing
- ✅ **Insecurity flags** — any value other than an explicit `0/false/no/off` is treated as enabled
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — no longer passes as valid TLS
- ✅ **Duplicates before limits** — one node with different names no longer pushes out legitimate configs

### 🌐 Addresses and protocols

- ✅ **`ipaddress` instead of regex** — 169.254/16, 100.64/10, 198.18/15,…

XieShawn-XXL/kaoyan-recommendation-platf.body:
# National Graduate Admissions Institutions Real-Time Data Platform

Project directory: `E:\考研推荐平台-真实数据版`

## Data Authenticity Principles

- The institution directory comes from the China Graduate Admissions Information Network (chsi) institution database: https://yz.chsi.com.cn/sch/
- The current official snapshot contains 939 master's admissions units.
- Each record keeps its official source link and sync time.
- When enrollment numbers, applicant numbers, re-exam cutoff scores, etc. have not been successfully parsed from official announcements, they are shown as “未公开” (not public). No estimated values are generated.

## Real-Time Update Mechanism

- `npm run sync:data`: immediately re-crawls all pages of the chsi network and atomically updates the local snapshot.
- `POST /api/sync`: clicking “立即同步最新数据” (sync latest data now) on the website triggers a forced refresh.
- `/api/schools`: reads the snapshot; if the snapshot is older than 6 hours, it is automatically re-synced.
- The API returns `Cache-Control: no-store`, so the frontend does not use stale interface caches.
- When the 408 snapshot is older than 1 hour, the query interface automatically starts a full background verification. During sync, the previous usable data continues to be served, and it is atomically switched over once complete.
- The 408 page automatically re-requests the interface every 5 minutes and displays the official data sync time and background update status.

## Majors and Exam Subjects

- The site queries 408 institutions, majors, departments, training modes, and the four initial-exam subjects through a single module, “Select schools and majors by exam subject” (按考试科目选学校和专业).
- `npm run sync:408`: verifies all 939 admissions units one by one and generates a strict unified-exam 408 full snapshot.
- The 408 list only includes records whose fourth initial-exam subject code is exactly `408`. Self-set subjects such as “计算机综合” (Computer Comprehensive) are not counted as 408.
- Each major record separately marks “学硕 / 专硕” (academic / professional master's). The official degree type is used first; when the official field is missing, it is completed based on major code rules.
- 408 results are linked to the admissions unit directory and display graduate school, self-set cutoff line, and Double First-Class tags.
- Filtering by Double First-Class / non-Double First-Class is supported. “本科背景友好度” (undergraduate-background friendliness) is only a sourced online reputation indicator, divided into relatively friendly, controversial, and insufficient information. It is not an official fact about the school.
- Institution tiers are labeled separately as 985, 211, and Double First-Class according to the Ministry of Education's historical project lists. 985 universities also keep the 211 tag; ordinary institutions indicate that none of the three tags apply.
- The planned enrollment numbers for 2026 and 2027 are displayed separately. When both years' numbers are public, expansion, reduction, or no change is calculated automatically. If 2027 has not been published, “未公布” (not yet announced) is shown explicitly.
- Precise filtering by English II (204) and Mathematics II (302) is supported, and the combined query “408 + English II + Math II” is available.
- The re-admission ratio is calculated per major as “re-exam candidates ÷ planned admissions.” It is only displayed when verifiable against an official list; otherwise it shows “未采集” (not collected).
- Re-admission ratios from non-chsi sources are labeled separately as “网络参考” (online reference), showing the source, the calculated headcount, and the confidence level. Calculations from official lists take priority, followed by summaries from authoritative institutions. Ordinary posts are not treated as facts.
- The 408 major table displays re-exam cutoff score references by year and supports filtering by highest score. School lines, national lines, and major lines are not mixed. Online references are marked separately.

XueyiXia/android-mvvm-architecture.body:
# android-mvvm-architecture

An MVVM development framework in Kotlin, suited to medium and large projects.

As Android projects have evolved, MVVM has become one of the more mainstream architectural approaches. This repository is based on the Kotlin language and attempts to encapsulate a set of basic MVVM framework suitable for medium and large projects, focusing on the layered design of page, data, and state management, reducing duplicate code, and improving project maintainability and extensibility.

> This project is not meant to replace mature mainstream architecture frameworks. Instead, it is a basic implementation built on an understanding of MVVM ideas, suited to my own projects and team.

## Project Overview

The core idea of MVVM is to separate page display, data processing, and state management, avoiding coupling large amounts of logic into Activity / Fragment.

The advantages of this architecture include:

- A lighter UI layer; pages are only responsible for display and event handling
- More centralized business logic, making it easier to maintain and extend
- Decoupling of the data layer and page layer, making testing and refactoring easier
- Convenient unified management of state and lifecycle in large projects

---

## MVVM Architecture Approach

The key components of MVVM are as follows:

- View: responsible for page display and user event handling
- ViewModel: connects UI and data, responsible for state management
- Repository: responsible for data retrieval, processing, and caching
- LiveData: responsible for reactive state updates
- BaseActivity / BaseFragment: unified page base classes that reduce duplicate code

The overall flow can be understood as:

View layer receives user action -> ViewModel handles business logic -> Repository fetches/processes data -> LiveData notifies UI update

---

## Key Module Descriptions

### 1. BaseActivity

`BaseActivity` is the page base class, responsible for encapsulating some common capabilities, such as:

- DataBinding binding
- Permission requests
- Back key handling
- Activity navigation
- Snackbar prompts
- Application exit logic
- Common initialization flow

This way each page does not need to repeat this common logic, and the code will be clearer.

### 2. BaseFragment

`BaseFragment` is the common base class for Fragment, mainly responsible for:

- Unified initialization flow
- Binding lifecycle
- Handling common events
- Reducing repetitive boilerplate code in Fragments

### 3. BaseViewModel

`BaseViewModel` is the basic abstract class for ViewModel, typically used to uniformly handle:

- Page state management
- LiveData / StateFlow type state
- Encapsulating common data callbacks
- Unified handling of communication between the business layer and UI layer

### 4. BaseRepository

`BaseRepository` is the base class for the data repository layer, suitable for handling:

- Network requests
- Local caching
- Data transformation

deepdiver-997/simulation-battle-system.body:
# Simulation Battle System — Turn-Based Spirit Battle Simulation Engine

## Project Overview

A turn-based spirit battle simulation engine in C++20. Battle flow is driven by a finite state machine, effects are scheduled by "timing points," and mechanics are registered into the kernel as data rather than hard-coded. Intended for battle simulation, AI self-play training, and mechanics research.

The project is in active development. The core battle flow is runnable; the effect system and scenario-based tests are still being expanded.

## Online Debug Console (Try It)

The web battle debug console is now open: form teams and start a battle, step through each timing point to view the judgment process, and use the live preview panel for Learning Power / Nature / Engraving.

- Address: `http://107.174.127.252:8070`
- Access token: `sbs-3021308f` (enter via the 🔑 button at the top right of the page; the browser saves it)
- The service is hosted on a US server, so a direct connection may not always succeed. If loading is slow or times out, retry or switch networks.
- Three steps to get started: enter the token → click "Sample lineup" → "▶ Start battle" (the "ℹ️ Instructions" button at the top right of the console has full guidance)
- Found behavior that doesn't match the in-game experience? Please open an issue, ideally attaching the console's "Export this match JSON" output. If you can't use GitHub, you can also email feedback: `feedback@scut.email`

### Browser Compatibility / Blank Page Troubleshooting (2026-09-28)

If the page won't open (completely blank), troubleshoot in this order:
1. **If there is a red error banner at the bottom of the page** → copy the text into an issue. That is the direct cause, and we'll fix it based on that.
2. **Old browser engines**: the debug console targets es2015, which covers the vast majority of browsers. If you use a very old built-in browser or a QQ/UC/Baidu webview, try the latest Chrome or Safari instead.
3. **Safari + LAN IP / private mode**: Safari may block localStorage for this origin (throwing a SecurityError). A safe fallback has been implemented, so in theory this no longer causes a blank page. If it still misbehaves, report the content of the red error banner.
4. **Proxy / tracking protection**: turn off the proxy and "Prevent cross-site tracking" and try again.
5. On mobile, use the system browser directly (iOS Safari / Android Chrome), not a web page inside an app.

## Architecture Overview

Data (SQLite) → assembly layer (spirit/skill objects) → effect kernel (registry + timing buckets) → FSM drives timing points one at a time → effects execute and read/write the battle context.

- **Fixed kernel, mechanics as data**: the kernel provides only a few registries (effects, rules, immunities, gear, etc.). New mechanics do not modify the FSM.
- **Pluggable effects**: effect implementations are loaded as dynamic library plugins and decoupled from the kernel through a C interface. (For the current state of plugin source and the data build pipeline, see "Data and Plugins" below.)
- **Semantic timing points**: each state of the state machine corresponds to a fixed effect registration timing point, ensuring a predictable judgment order.

1. **Battle system**: skill use, type matchups, damage pipeline, status conditions, and other core battle logic.

dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy.body:
An independent [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle plugin. It connects the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine (**both the China and international editions of WorkBuddy AI are supported**) to DSH's model selector. It also provides an account pool, checkable model management, and a set of read-only credit features: **on each refresh, the credit multiplier for each model is read automatically from the upstream catalog** (values like `x0.79`; the multipliers come entirely from upstream, and the plugin neither hardcodes nor guesses them), per-model toggles for image input, multi-account switching with automatic account rotation in the pool, daily check-in, and capsule-style read-only credit readouts on cards and in the input box. **The China and international editions are two parallel providers (`workbuddy` / `workbuddy-global`) and can be used at the same time.** The plugin settings card uses tabs to tell the two apart for unified management. You only need the local WorkBuddy login session, **or to log in once in a browser**.

## Risk Notice

> **WorkBuddy has started restricting requests from unofficial clients. This project does not guarantee that the related interfaces will stay available long-term. If upstream tightens its restrictions, the plugin may stop working. Please read the [“Disclaimer”](#免责声明) at the end of this document first and assess the account risk yourself. Using the official WorkBuddy client is always the safest choice.**

To be clear, the purpose of this plugin is quite ordinary: **to save you the hassle of switching back and forth between the WorkBuddy client and DSH**. You have already signed in to WorkBuddy on your own machine. The plugin only connects that existing login session to DSH's model selector so you can use it where you write code. It does not provide accounts, share credentials, or bypass billing. Every call consumes **your own account's** quota and is charged for real at the multiplier upstream provides. The plugin never modifies account state and includes no privilege-escalation or quota-farming capability.

It relies on the WorkBuddy client's own interfaces (unofficial, non-public APIs), so the plugin may need to be adjusted when upstream changes. This is normal for tools of this kind, and it is the reason this notice exists. **Please assess the account risk yourself before deciding whether to install.**

The international edition is registered as the `workbuddy-global` provider (`GPT-5.6`, `Gemini-3.5-Flash`, `GLM-5.3`, `Kimi-K3`, etc.). **Models from any region where you have an account will appear in DSH…

jiesou/dsh-opencode-zen-free-provider.body:
# dsh-opencode-zen-free-provider

OpenCode Zen Free provider for dsh.

[English](https://github.com/jiesou/dsh-opencode-zen-free-provider/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

This plugin lets you use OpenCode Zen's free models with dsh. When the plugin starts, it syncs the model catalog and all metadata from OpenCode Zen and models.dev, **fetching only once**, with no polling. Even if the fetch fails at startup, the plugin still mounts normally, and routing serves from an empty catalog.

The context window follows the models.dev metadata by default. **Exceptions: MiMo V2.6 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM 5.3 Flash**: their backend services actually support more than the 200K listed for the free tier, so this plugin declares measured values (1M for the first two, 600K for GLM 5.3 Flash). Testing showed `deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` still returns 200 at 1.04 million prompt tokens, and it accurately retrieves a needle buried 93% deep in a 3MB document. The real ceiling is request body size (about 3.9MB of characters), not the context window. `glm-5.3-flash-free` (upstream routes to `perplexity/glm-5.3-flash`) likewise retrieves a marker buried 93% deep at 264K prompt tokens, still returns 200 at 617K tokens, and is rejected with upstream `context_length_exceeded` starting at 659K tokens. So it is declared as 600K rather than the paid tier's 1M.

## Installation

Install from npm (prebuilt artifacts, recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jiesou/dsh-opencode-zen-free-provider
```

Or install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiesou/dsh-opencode-zen-free-provider
```

## After installation

The model list **requires no configuration**. When the plugin starts, it automatically syncs from the remote source and filters out all free models. Select OpenCode Zen Free and a model on the Web Models page to start using it.

## Reasoning effort

Models only expose the levels the upstream accepts; no levels are invented. **Default** means the `reasoning_effort` field is not sent, leaving the depth to the upstream. **Off** is a real toggle: it sends the upstream's literal off value (`none`, `off`, etc.). zhwen2703-hash/kaoyan-recommendation-pla.body:
# National Postgraduate Admissions Unit Real-Time Data Platform

Project directory: `E:\考研推荐平台-真实数据版`

## Data Authenticity Principles

- The admissions unit directory comes from the institution database of the China Graduate Admissions Information Network (中国研究生招生信息网): https://yz.chsi.com.cn/sch/
- The current official snapshot contains 939 master's admissions units.
- Each record retains the official source link and sync time.
- Enrollment numbers, applicant numbers, re-exam cutoff lines, and similar figures that could not be parsed from official announcements are shown as “Not disclosed” and no estimated values are generated.

## Real-Time Update Mechanism

- `npm run sync:data`: immediately re-fetches all pages from the graduate admissions website and atomically updates the local snapshot.
- `POST /api/sync`: triggered by clicking “立即同步最新数据” (“Sync latest data now”) on the website, forcing a refresh.
- `/api/schools`: reads the snapshot; if the snapshot is older than 6 hours, it automatically re-syncs.
- The API returns `Cache-Control: no-store`, so the frontend does not use cached responses from earlier API calls.
- When the 408 snapshot is older than 1 hour, the query endpoint automatically starts a background full verification. During sync, the previous usable data continues to be served, and the data is atomically switched upon completion.
- The 408 page automatically re-requests the API every 5 minutes and displays the official data sync time and background update status.

## Majors and Exam Subjects

- The site queries 408 schools, majors, departments, training modes, and the four preliminary exam subjects through the “Select schools and majors by exam subject” module.
- `npm run sync:408`: verifies all 939 admissions units one by one and generates a strict unified-exam 408 full snapshot.
- The 408 list only includes records whose fourth preliminary exam subject code is exactly `408`. Self-set subjects such as “计算机综合” (Computer Comprehensive) are not counted as 408.
- Each major record is separately labeled “学硕 / 专硕” (academic / professional master's). The official degree type is prioritized, and when the official field is missing, it is completed based on major code rules.
- 408 results are linked to the admissions unit directory and display graduate school, self-set score line, and Double First-Class tags.
- Supports filtering Double First-Class / non-Double First-Class. “本科背景友好度” (undergraduate-background friendliness) is shown only as sourced online reputation, categorized as relatively friendly, disputed, or insufficient information, and is not treated as an official school fact.
- School tiers are labeled separately per the Ministry of Education's historical project lists: 985, 211, and Double First-Class. 985 universities also retain the 211 label. Ordinary institutions indicate that none of the three labels apply.
- Separately displays 2026 and 2027 planned enrollment. When both years are public, it automatically calculates expansion, reduction, or no change. When 2027 is unpublished, it clearly shows “未公布” (not yet published).
- Supports precise filtering by English II (204) and Mathematics II (302), and can combine queries such as “408 + 英二 + 数二” (408 + English II + Mathematics II).
- The re-admission ratio is calculated per major as “re-exam applicants ÷ planned admits.” It is shown only when verifiable against official lists; otherwise it shows “未采集” (not collected).
- Re-admission ratios not from the graduate admissions website are labeled “网络参考” (online reference), showing the source, counted numbers, and confidence level. Official list calculations take priority, followed by authoritative institutional summaries. Ordinary posts are not directly treated as fact.
- The 408 major table displays year-tagged major re-exam cutoff references and supports filtering by highest score. School lines, national lines, and major lines are not mixed, and online references are labeled separately.
- …
